test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jun, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Six friends X, Y, J, M, N, and O are standing in a queue facing north. Y is immediately behind O. J is standing at the end of the queue. M stands exactly in between N and X. Y does not stand after X. Who stands fourth from the start of the queue?
solution:
Six friends X, Y, J, M, N, and O are standing in a queue facing north.

1) J is standing at the end of the queue.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ffddf28316522bd4094a2893e7c478259e0515a8eff9752eb5d7fb579ab1b92a.png] 

2) M stands exactly in between N and X.

Case (i) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2f3dfe4f75b524904c92ad65005699123647ea959f9e057fd0f7055e739adce3.png] 

Case (ii) : 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b4e7f2862fe461148169e9ccd5eec33500e0444dc0a48e2ce0de2273cb4835cf.png] 

3) Y is immediately behind O and Y does not stand after X.

Case(ii) does not satisfy given statement.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5441de81a0a68b29bbdf88a387c87111f1b1565f3d488d70d9ec7fd2e297dc76.png] 

∴ Here, 'M' stands fourth from the start of the queue.

Hence, the correct answer is **"M".**
